why_best: It visually unifies geographically separated points into a cohesive story of scale and movement within a quick four-second consumer moment.
why_bad: Static callout pins or abrupt pop-up markers would sever the spatial narrative, feeling like a fragmented checklist rather than a thriving system.
trap: A near-miss will clutter the layout with overlapping pathways at uniform brightness, hiding the underlying geography beneath a chaotic tangle.
